intro.title: Discover Auberge del Porvenir
intro.text_1: Located between Santa Marta and Minca, Auberge del Porvenir welcomes you to a natural setting where the jungle meets the light of the Caribbean. Just minutes from the city yet already worlds away, the atmosphere immediately invites you to slow down and breathe.
intro.text_2: Here, days begin with birdsong and end beneath a sky painted with warm sunset colors. Surrounded by tropical vegetation, open spaces, and a peaceful atmosphere, every detail is designed to offer a simple, authentic, and relaxing stay.
intro.text_3: Whether you wish to explore the mountains of the Sierra Nevada, discover the nearby beaches, or simply enjoy a quiet moment, Auberge del Porvenir is the perfect starting point to fully experience your stay in Colombia.

location.title: Explore the surroundings
location.text_1: Ideally located near some of the most iconic destinations on the Caribbean coast, our inn is the perfect starting point to discover the region’s cultural and natural richness. Between paradise beaches, lush mountains, and vibrant cities, every excursion promises a unique experience.
location.text_2: Whether you are a nature lover, seeking relaxation, or looking for adventure, everything is within reach to enrich your stay.

cta.title: Ready to experience Porvenir?
cta.text: Between lush jungle and a peaceful river, Auberge del Porvenir welcomes you for a timeless escape. Whether you're traveling as a couple, with friends, or solo, come and discover an authentic place between Santa Marta and Minca.
